sequence_prerequisite.policy: Polymarket recensus must not execute until ForecastEx census is closed on main.

source_contract.pagination: Use next_cursor as after_cursor until exhausted; offset is forbidden.
source_contract.reason: Official documentation states closed markets/events are excluded by default unless closed=true and recommends events-based complete discovery; keyset pagination is the current stable exhaustive route.

population.definition: Every closed event returned by exhaustive official Gamma keyset pagination, with associated markets supplied in the event payload.
population.w2_role: Existing W2-C semantic/adjudication artifacts are audit-only overlap evidence and may not suppress newly discovered events or force inclusion.

semantic_contract.family_rules: Byte-identical W4B-SC-v1.0 strict rules and same-mechanism precedence.
semantic_contract.classification: Exactly one strict family => ACCEPT_STRICT_FAMILY; same-mechanism precedence may resolve overlap; cross-mechanism overlap => AMBIGUOUS; zero => REJECT.

venue_event_unit.definition: One Gamma event is one venue event before canonicalization; all associated threshold/outcome markets remain aliases under that event.
venue_event_unit.multi_event_alias_policy: Distinct Gamma event IDs that canonicalize to the same W4CE1 id are same-occurrence aliases and collapse before any N claim.

canonicalization.event_reference_date: First valid Gamma endDate UTC calendar date; missing/unparseable endDate => CANONICALIZATION_AMBIGUOUS at this pre-official-truth stage.
canonicalization.subject_key: Reuse byte-identical subject_key implementation from scripts/w4b_kalshi_semantic_canonicalize_v1.py; macro releases therefore use the same US family keys.
canonicalization.cross_venue_claim_limit: Canonical equality is a deterministic duplicate candidate only; final alias adjudication occurs in the next cross-venue dedup stage.

transport_gate.4xx_policy: Unexpected 4xx is unresolved and fails materialization.
transport_gate.duplicate_event_id_policy: Deduplicate repeated API rows by Gamma event id and record duplicate count; duplicate rows do not add N.

gate.n_claim: Accepted Polymarket canonical counts remain venue census capacity, not cross-venue unique N or N_final_backtestable.
